parts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. SIX-view 360 turntable atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, native1536x1024 or larger. Design identity reference: LEFT front and RIGHT back of the SAME After Hours Hoodie. Preserve the EXACT physical garment and colour #78846a, Cotton 100% định lượng cao, Relaxed fit; exact neckline/hood, sleeve length and pose, cloth drape and folds, all seams/pockets/closures/trim/hem from that reference. Construction hints {"hem":"rib","panel":"none","collar":"hood","sleeve":"long","stripe":false,"zipper":false,"pockets":"kangaroo"}; the image is authoritative if hints differ. Preserve small front ML and the original back artwork exactly: if the reference has floral M plus MiloShopHand, keep that artwork; if it has script only, keep script only. Never invent text or mirror artwork. Frames 0,15,30,45,60,75 degrees: exact FRONT first, gradually turn the garment's FRONT towards the LEFT of each image, ending almost LEFT-FACING PROFILE. Front chest ML gradually foreshortens. No back artwork visible. Read the 6 angles in row-major order. Physical upright VERTICAL Y-axis rotation, fixed level camera, no pitch, roll, leaning, or rotating a flat image. Every cell shows full garment, same height and center, 5% margin, accurate narrow side silhouette. Only ONE garment per cell; no person/mannequin/hanger/stand. Soft premium photographic cloth, neutral pale ivory background and consistent light. No labels, numbers, angle captions, borders, grids, gutters or watermark. Six DISTINCT views, no repeated front or rear views.
